answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tied to capital lockup rather than ephemeral digital signatures. To bridge different sub-networks, agents must stake native assets, acting like a jade pillar in a shifting digital landscape. An attacker faces an exponential cipher of costs, as gaining control requires acquiring a majority stake, rendering the creation of infinite fake identities economically non-viable and computationally prohibitive.
